query: 物种多样性保护 物种多样性保护 衡量企业对关键物种与生物多样性保护的体系化管理。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：披露了受影响的 IUCN 红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单，设定了明确的种群保护/恢复量化目标，建立了长效监测指标（如物种丰富度、丰度），并与学术机构或 NGO 建立了长期合作机制。 • 1分（合格）：识别了运营区域的敏感物种，有定性的保护措施描述（如避开繁殖期、设置禁猎牌），但缺乏量化的保护目标或系统的长期监测数据。 • 0分（不合格）：无物种保护相关披露，或仅有笼统的“关爱动植物”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：保护机制覆盖 >80% 已识别的生物多样性重点区域、高敏感项目或受影响物种栖息地。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对明星物种（如大熊猫）进行保护而忽略其他受威胁物种，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关信息。 物种保护 敏感物种 受影响物种 国家重点保护物种 IUCN红色名录 受威胁物种 特有种 栖息地保护 繁殖期避让 物种丰富度 物种丰度 生物多样性行动计划 生物多样性监测 环境DNA 红外相机 species conservation sensitive species affected species protected species IUCN Red List threatened species endemic species habitat protection breeding season avoidance species richness species abundance biodiversity action plan BAP biodiversity monitoring environmental DNA eDNA camera traps 是否披露受影响的IUCN红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单？ 是否设定种群保护/恢复量化目标？ 有哪些长期监测指标（如丰富度、丰度）？ 采取了哪些保护措施？ 是否与科研机构或NGO长期合作？ 机制覆盖哪些重点区域或栖息地？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '物种多样性保护'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否披露受影响的IUCN红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单？ 是否设定种群保护/恢复量化目标？ 有哪些长期监测指标（如丰富度、丰度）？ 采取了哪些保护措施？ 是否与科研机构或NGO长期合作？ 机制覆盖哪些重点区域或栖息地？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“关爱动植物”；仅有办公室绿植或园区绿化；仅有一般土地复垦而无物种管理；仅有捐赠野生动物基金而无运营影响管理；区分：本指标聚焦关键物种与生物多样性的识别、目标、监测与保护机制；一般环境政策或绿化美化不能替代物种保护体系披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

Climate Change & Emissions (Air, Land, Water)

[Content]
Currently, there is a high composition of plastic material in our products, with plastic making up 30 to 40% of our final product by weight, contributing to high CO 2 emissions. To reduce the impact of our products on the environment and mitigate the potential climate-related risks identified, Home Control has formed a committee and set policies to recommend the use of recycled materials and PCR resin in products to customers. In the year, we managed to increase the ratio of PCR resin within our products by 2.09% from FY2020, thereby reducing CO 2 emissions by 11.38 tonnes. We currently also have a strong business continuity plan for our supply chains, described on page 19 of this report, under 'Supply chains and Business continuity'.

results.text: Transition risks Changes in regulations | As China seeks to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060, many industries have been affected by new regulations such as energy efficiency benchmarks. As Home Control has manufacturing facilities in China, our manufacturing costs may increase as a result. Home Control frequently monitors the regulatory changes under current ISO14001 system requirements. Additionally, we conduct cross function assessments against the latest regulatory changes reported by third-party service agency such as SGS Hong Kong Limited. Changes in consumer expectations | There is a growing consciousness of environmental issues among consumers around the world. Accordingly, we may be affected by an increase in demand for environmentally- friendly products, and would need to ensure that we are well-positioned to turn this into a business opportunity. Currently, one of our key perpetual targets is to meet our customers' environmental requirements related to their products. Home Control has also dedicated an Environmental and Sustainability team to manage customer's environmental requirements on product level. Furthermore, a cross function 'Green Team' has been established for the study and implementation of environmentally friendly technologies and new materials on our product. Physical risks Extreme weather events | The sixth assessment report by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has indicated that at the current rate of global warming, there would likely be an increased frequency of extreme weather events. For Home Control, this could mean potential disruptions in our supply chains. With regards to the management of supply chain disruption risks due to extreme weather events, Home Control has implemented/in the process of implementing the following: • Contingency plans to buffer from the effects of sudden bad weather events. The addition cost of production from contingency plan will be included in the Bill of Materials (BOM). • Supply risks assessment and tracking system that has been developed to help monitor and detect abnormal situation.

results.text: Beyond replacing plastic packaging material with paper-based packaging certified by the Forest Stewardship Council, Home Control conducted an Ocean-Bound Plastic (OBP) study to explore other waste management effort that the company can adopt in reducing ocean plastic. Specifically, OBP aims to reduce involuntary littering by issuing certifications to organization for the collection or recycling of ocean plastic. A study was conducted for 2 OBP Resin from one of our local Vendors, Kingfa. With Kingfa being a key production side for Resin CK-150 and CK-250, Kingfa expressed its interest in adopting OBP waste management method. As such, a primary dry-run and reliability tests were conducted for CK-150 and CK-250. Home Control concluded that we will be working closely with UL to apply for the certification, which are ready November 2021.

Innovation

[Content]
Beyond replacing plastic packaging material with paper-based packaging certified by the Forest Stewardship Council, Home Control conducted an Ocean-Bound Plastic (OBP) study to explore other waste management effort that the company can adopt in reducing ocean plastic. Specifically, OBP aims to reduce involuntary littering by issuing certifications to organization for the collection or recycling of ocean plastic. A study was conducted for 2 OBP Resin from one of our local Vendors, Kingfa. With Kingfa being a key production side for Resin CK-150 and CK-250, Kingfa expressed its interest in adopting OBP waste management method. As such, a primary dry-run and reliability tests were conducted for CK-150 and CK-250. Home Control concluded that we will be working closely with UL to apply for the certification, which are ready November 2021.
